description: This file defines a route component for editing notes in a Remix-based React application. It includes server-side loader and action functions for fetching and updating/deleting a note, along with a React component that renders a form for editing a note's title and content.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads a note by ID after verifying user authentication.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submissions for saving or deleting the note.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: React component rendering the note editing interface with save/delete options.
